attack_vectors.name: Symlink escape via pre-placed link
attack_vectors.description: Malicious symlink inside parent_home points outside it; worker inherits the escape

attack_vectors.name: Branch name path traversal
attack_vectors.description: branch='../../../etc/cron.d' passed to git worktree add

attack_vectors.name: rm-rf escape via cleanup
attack_vectors.description: cleanup_worktree called with path outside configured root

attack_vectors.name: CODEX_HOME env injection
attack_vectors.description: CODEX_HOME set to /etc or another sensitive path in environment
attack_vectors.mitigated_by: CODEX_HOME resolved and checked against worktree_root when root explicitly set

resolved_path_strategy.symlink_atomicity: os.symlink is atomic on POSIX — no TOCTOU between resolve and syscall
resolved_path_strategy.cleanup_toctou: shutil.rmtree is non-atomic — TOCTOU window exists on cleanup path (accepted, see residual risks)

residual_risks.description: Race window between is_relative_to check and shutil.rmtree; adversary with parent-dir write access could rename a sensitive directory into the rmtree path
residual_risks.mitigation: Accepted — requires higher-privilege attacker than threat model; fd-pinning mitigation out of scope

residual_risks.description: All '/' in branch names rejected; callers needing git namespace branches (feat/x) must use alternate separator
residual_risks.mitigation: Conservative design choice to eliminate full traversal class

residual_risks.description: CODEX_HOME env check only active when worktree_root explicitly set; legacy WorkerIsolator() callers lack D-vector protection
residual_risks.mitigation: Backwards-compatibility trade-off; callers should migrate to WorkerIsolator(worktree_root=...) to activate all guards
